concept_decisions: Keep concept sharp interlocking divides and branching gullies; remove independent decorative spires. Construct one coherent tilted hill mass with dendritic incisions that join a central downstream collector; vary branch angle, length and order, sharp narrow divides retained. Gully floors drain toward front. Avoid symmetrical fishbone rows and shallow painted lines. Neutral subdued sediment color secondary to real geometry.
